Definition: {a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed; by implication, a Chaldaean (as if so descended); also an astrologer (as if proverbial of that people}
BiblicalUsage: Chaldean = see Chaldea "clod-breakers"; 1) a group of people usually associated with the area around Babylonia; 2) the learned class of priests, magicians, or astronomers
